title: How to Meet People as a Solo Traveler
paragraphs: There are many good things about traveling solo. You can go where you want and spend some time with yourself.
But it can also get lonely. So here's how you can make friends when you're traveling solo!
Hostels are some of the best places to meet people when traveling. Many people who stay in hostels are solo travelers too, so they may also be looking to make friends!
And lots of hostels have events every day — like group dinners and movie nights — so it's easy to start talking to other travelers.
Short group tours can also help you meet people. You can join a walking tour, a food tour or a day trip with other travelers.
You may also find people you want to spend more time with after the tour!
Apps like Meetup, Couchsurfing and Bumble BFF can help you find other travelers near you, or just people who live in the area. You can ask them to go to an event or meet for coffee!
Many hostels also have group chats for their guests on these apps, so it's easy to make plans with the people you meet.
You can also meet people by taking a class — and learn something new at the same time! You can try to learn the language of the place you're in, or do a cooking class or a dance class.
There are many things you can do to meet people when traveling solo!
